messages:
Priya: Hey team — quick proposal: can we move the weekly triage from Wed 10am to Tue 9am? Backlog owners are overlapping with product syncs on Wed. Also want to add a 5m 'owner spotlight' to quickly reassign stale bugs.
Tom: Tue 9 works for me. Less clash with my calendar. :thumbsup: 
Aisha: I prefer mornings, Tue 9 is OK but can we do 9:15 if needed? Short window for prepping.
Jorge: +1 for the owner spotlight. Maybe structure agenda like:
```
1) Quick metrics (2m)
2) Owner spotlight (5m) - reassign 2-3 stale bugs
3) Hot queue triage (15m)
4) Action items & owners (3m)
```
Priya: Thanks — 9 or 9:15 fine. My main ask is keeping total to 25m max. We can rotate owner spotlight each week.
Tom: How about we run this for 3 weeks as a pilot and collect feedback? I'll add an agenda template to the doc.
infra-bot: Reminder set: weekly triage -> Tue 09:00 UTC starting next week (channel: #eng). Link: https://calendar.example/triage
Aisha: Pilot sounds good. Can owners nominate themselves here? I'll volunteer to kick off week 1.
Jorge: I'll take week 2. @Tom can you add the pilot note to the recurring invite and set a poll for 9 vs 9:15?
Tom: On it — adding poll now. Poll: Tue 09:00 vs Tue 09:15 (please vote). Vote link: https://poll.example/s/triage-time
Priya: If poll settles 9:15, we'll target that. Thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
